verdict.rationale: Segment's own docs pages carry 'Open in ChatGPT / Open in Claude / Open in Cursor / Open in Perplexity' handoff buttons, and the Public API publishes a downloadable OpenAPI specification. Together these are first-party, agent-friendly documentation affordances. However, probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at segment.com/llms.txt) and no markdown docs variant (HTTP 404 at /docs/.md), so there is no documented single entry point to point an agent at. missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, raw markdown versions of docs pages, documentation describing the agent-oriented docs features, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can consume the docs.
